correctness.rationale: The published all-n wedge of n−1 S² proves integral rank/concentration. A complete 122-face C10 independence-complex collapse with 48 validated free pairs proves primitive two-color generator. Orbit conflict graphs C5/P6 and signed Lefschetz compute the swap/reflection degree as −1; odd-order rotation has degree +1. Every color merge is simplicial; the n−1 coordinate retractions give a split integral basis and establish the augmentation-lattice relations. Checker replays 36,888 map instances, 1,520 group elements and mod-two Betti calculations. Finite tests are not used to generalize n.

value.rationale: The fully specified integral S_n × D5 module, primitive color-pair spherical generators and uniform reflection sign classify symmetry-level homology for all n, beyond the known nonequivariant Betti numbers. The projection argument distinguishes a definite integral augmentation lattice rather than just a rational character, and supplies reusable geometric generators. This is an intrinsic natural invariant of an established infinite family, not an arbitrary finite computation.
